response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(analysis_count) AS total_count, AVG(analysis_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(c.analysis_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(1.0 * c.analysis_count / totals.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.analysis_count - totals.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE c.analysis_count > totals.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: A trader with a NULL tradekind forms one group when counting trader types, following SQLite GROUP BY behavior.

alternatives.interpretation: Only non-NULL trader types count as trader types; analyses for traders with a NULL tradekind are excluded from both the total and the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON r.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = r.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(analysis_count) AS total_count, AVG(analysis_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(c.analysis_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(1.0 * c.analysis_count / totals.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.analysis_count - totals.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals WHERE c.analysis_count > totals.average_count;
